migration_rule: Changing a frozen surface requires a named schema or protocol version change plus regression tests.

state_policy_bridge.rule: The recurrent distribution is the baseline. Existing state may apply bounded deterministic pressure before selection; all family contributions are audited.
state_policy_bridge.action_values: retained as durable accounting but not double-counted into the bridge while recurrent reinforcement is already causal
state_policy_bridge.relevance_gate: relationships require current decision actor overlap; commitments require current decision overlap; autobiographical history requires retrieved record overlap with current decision; concerns require current decision overlap when a decision context is supplied
state_policy_bridge.clipping: each mechanism/action contribution is clipped to family_cap, aggregate/action pressure to total_cap, then a 1e-9 positive floor is applied and scores are normalized to sum to one
state_policy_bridge.lesion: bridge_enabled=false zeroes all state pressure and returns the normalized recurrent-only path without mutating recurrent weights
